title: Known retail products and equipment cannot illustrate the business story
steps: Run run.cmd and require four passing tests with no skips.
expect: Positively labelled product and equipment photos are absent from About story while retained as assets and gallery photos.
Stored nested vision labels and legacy product subjects obey the same boundary.
Product-only sources leave the story without a photo; unlabelled images are not guessed from captions.

tests: retail product and equipment photographs cannot illustrate the business story
stored vision labels and legacy positive product subjects also exclude a story photo
a product-only catalogue leaves the story without a photograph and keeps its product assets
an unlabelled picture is not inferred to be a product from its caption
